@'
import sys, json, collections
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/alpha-launch/tools/launch"); sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/alpha-launch/tools/registry")
import launch, cellhash_reg
rd = lambda p: {d["hash"]: d for d in map(json.loads, filter(str.strip, open(p)))}
C = rd("/data/tk0268/metrics-C.jsonl"); A = rd("/data/tk0268/metrics-A.jsonl"); P = launch.hash_metrics_file()
L = launch.letopis()
miss = [r for r in L["rows"] if r["status"]!="none" and r["sharpe"] is None and r["winrate"] is None]
pnl = collections.defaultdict(dict)
for l in open(launch.REG + "/results.jsonl"):
    if l.strip():
        d = json.loads(l); pnl[d["cell_id"]][d["month"]] = d.get("pnl_usd")
byh = collections.defaultdict(dict)
for row in cellhash_reg.build():
    for m, v in pnl.get(row[0], {}).items(): byh[row[1]][m] = v
seen=set()
for r in miss:
    h=r["hash"]; g=r["hyp"]
    if g in seen or h not in A and h not in C and h not in P: continue
    seen.add(g)
    mt = A.get(h) or C.get(h) or P.get(h)
    canon = {m:v for m,v in byh[h].items() if v is not None}
    bm = {m: round(v["pnl"],2) for m,v in mt["by_month"].items()}
    print(g, h[:12], "canon", {m:round(v,2) for m,v in sorted(canon.items())}, "\n     closes", dict(sorted(bm.items())))
